description: Cancel one of your MCP Events subscriptions (or webhooks) by its subscription_id from list_event_subscriptions: nothing more is sent to it, and anything queued is dropped. Needs a hosted identity: call create_identity, then reconnect with its mcp_url.

subscription_id.description: The subscription_id list_event_subscriptions shows (sub_... for an event subscription)

name: cancel_event_subscription
title: Cancel event subscription
